## Objective
- Finish the existing project as a complete, playable Italian-language idle game.

## Requirements
- Build without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for visual checks at viewport width ≤1280px and inspect only the latest.
- Keep gameplay fictional, with virtual rewards and no real mining, blockchain, wallet, or fund transfers.

- Implemented “MINER // Protocollo Aurora” as an idle exploration game with browser-local saves and offline progress capped at 8 hours.
- Added a data-URL favicon to prevent the browser’s `/favicon.ico` 404.

## Work State
### Completed
- Replaced the Bitcoin-monitor interface with the Italian game UI and gameplay systems: bot fleet, six unlockable networks, upgrades, manual scans, pause/resume, rank progression, sequential missions, demo routing, sound toggle, reset confirmation, and local/offline saves.

- `node --check app.js`, `python3 -m py_compile server.py`, and `git diff --check` passed.

### Blocked
- Reliable Playwright click interaction remains unresolved; `playwright-cli click 'Scansione manuale'` and `playwright-cli click e1e160` both reported the target did not match any elements.

1. Verify core interactions using supported Playwright selectors or another browser-testing approach.
2. Check the responsive layout at a mobile viewport and save/read only the latest JPEG if recapturing.
3. Review final diff and report completion; no commit or push was made.

- `index.html`: Game UI, Italian labels, and inline favicon.
- `app.js`: Game logic, progression, saves, and interactions.
- `style.css`: Visual design and responsive styling.
- `README.md`: Game overview and fictional-game boundaries.
- `screenshots/aurora.jpg`: Latest captured UI screenshot.

- Changes are uncommitted; modified files are `app.js`, `index.html`, `style.css`, and `README.md`.
